title: Rabbi Elazar ben Mehavai

paragraphs: (A Tanna of a baraita.) He is mentioned in Shabbat 106b on the law of one who catches locusts on Shabbat: he says that if they were coming in swarms he is exempt; so it is in the Tosefta there, chapter 13. He is likewise mentioned in Yevamot 102a and Bava Metzia 27a: “they testify on a mole.”

notes.text: The William Davidson digital text has the mole testimony at Yevamot 120a, with Rabbi Eliezer ben Mehavai, and Bava Metzia 27b, with Elazar. Hyman’s supplied Yevamot 102a and Bava Metzia 27a remain alongside those matching locations. שומא here is a mole, not an unspecified identifying sign; the Elazar/Eliezer distinction is retained.
